title: A stranger with a sick child
story: At dusk a woman beaches a small boat below the houses. Her child burns with fever. She has come from upriver and asks for a place by your fire.

choices.label: Take them in
choices.result: The family shares its rice and a mat. The child's fever spreads to one of your own, but the mother stays to work your fields.

choices.label: Give rice for the journey
choices.result: She thanks you and paddles on toward the next barangay, a bundle of rice at her feet.

choices.label: Turn them away
choices.result: The boat slips back into the dark. Some of your people whisper about it for days.

_note: Travel by boat along rivers and coasts was the everyday way people and news moved between barangays.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994), on river and coastal travel between settlements
